content: Obeca abentsëc bënudtequid
Adashic, icsaquid utsibobëd ancanquidën matsesën aton na buansho isun aton na bedtequid nëidtedi bedta caido, Tantianu, quiash Esus datsidadpanëdash.
Adsho isash padiseyobo Esus tantiamenquio yec chushquiacbimboec, Abi datsidadquido icsambocquid icsho cacumenquiocquin aidobëdtambi peshun Esusën aquec, quec abibi onquecuededpanëdash.
Adoaquien, tantiaquidquio iquec Esus:
—¿Min obeca dadpen 100ted icboedi abentsëc bënudacsho isun, Nibënu, quequin min obeca utsi dadpen 99ted nianec nibënec nidenquioda mibi icpe?
Aidi nibënquin istuidash, Con obeca istuidbosh bëdambo iquebi, queshun chiadquin buanec icbo nidec.
Shubuno choshon abëd icquido ambi yuedaidobëdta chomeshun: “Con obeca bënudaid istuidshun bëbosh bëdambo iquebique. Nuquibi penuna,” quequin icbon chuipec.
Adecbidi Nuquin Papa tantiaquid dadpen icnuc matses icsaquid abentsëcshun abi icsaid ënsho isash abuc Nuquin Papabëd tabadquido bëdamboshë iquebi, quecuededpendac —quepanëdash Esus.
Aton na bedtequid bënudtequid
Aden icbon aton yua bënudaid chuishumbic utsi chiec Esus nadpanëdash: —¿Aton na bedtequid shocoshëmpi 10ted icboedi abentsëc nibëdsho isun tabote taboshon bescaquin chidon nibënenquioda icpec?
Ai. Aden nibënquin istuidshun abëd icquido chomeshun: ‘Con shocoshëmpi abentsëc niadacboedi nibënquin istuidash bëdambo iquebi,’ quepec chido.
“Adecbidi matses abentsëcshun abi icsaid ënsho isash abi yacnocquido ambi uaido mayan bëdabobëdi Nuquin Papa bëdambo iquebi, quecuededec —quepanëdash Esus.
Aton mado cuëshëdquid
Aden chido chiashic utsi chiacbimboec Esus nadpanëdash: —Aton mado daëd icnubi
tsyuec tishaid aton papa caic: ‘Tsusio budquin mimbi chiondacpaden nëbi ëbi aidted meneta, papa,’ quepondash. Adoac aton na musucshun aton mado abi daëdi menebampondash.
“Aden meniac daëdpactsëc ushash aton mado tsyuecquid aton natedi sandoshon buanec nidaid utsi yacno nidash icsamboen nabanec tabadnuc aton natedi naimëdpondash.
Aden aton natedi naimëdambic tiedën caniquid unësbunian abi nidacnocquidon pete naimëdan tsusion mado chedo comapenec bundocuededpondash.
Adec bundoquiec abi nidacnocquid abentsëc yacno nidshun: ‘Mimbi namiaid ictiadquio iquebi,’ caquien: ‘Con chancho pemebanta,’ queshun aton chancho yacno tsusion mado nidmepondash.
Aden nidmiac nidquin chancho pemebanequi ambi chancho pemiaid petiadquio yec tabadshobi anocquidon menenquio icpondash.
“Adec natiambo bunec tabadquin aton papa ambi nianondaidbëdta abi icsaid utsitedi tantiec abibi onquec nadpondash: ‘Con pan namiaidon pete dadpen icnubi con na nibëdnuc unëspebi.
Nëbi con pa yacno nidshun naden con pa chiembi: Nuquin Papan chiacpaden nainquiocquin mibi tantienquio yec nidshun icsamboen nabanombique.
Adquid icsho con mado nec, ëbi cainda, papa. Nëbi min yuapadquid ëbi icme,’ quequin chiembi,

abibi quianec aton papa yacno nidoapondash. Adec nidec ancuenquio yacno aton mado nidondaid casenash chosho isash unësquiocnoc aton mado bëquedquin dayumbudshun shubi uatanquin aton papan tanchoccapondash.

Adoac ambibi tantiabocpaden aton papa chuiquin: ‘Nuquin Papan chiacpaden nainquiocquin mibi tantienquio yec nidshun icsamboen nabanec tabadteniobi. Aden naquid con mado ëbi cainda, papa. Min yuapadquid ëbi icme,’ capondash aton madon.

“Aden chiaquien bëdambo yanshun ambi namiaidombo naden aton papan chuipondash: ‘Con mado ënden nidondaid choaoshe. Dasiuidte bëdaidquio bëshun con mado dasiuinta. Adoshombic mëusudtetsen mëusunta. Adoshombic tapucudtetsen tasiuinta.
Adoshombic, bacan bacuë nuacquid dapa bedshun cuesuneta nuquitedi bëdamboec tabadquin penun.
Con mado unësacbimboecboedi nëbi ëbëdi tabadoaic. Aidi bënudacbimboecboedi nëbi istuidacbimboec choash iquec,’ cac bacan bacuë cuesuneshun codocacsho pebededpondash.
“Adnubien bëyuc tishaid tied nantan icpondash. Auëshquio nidec shubu anoentsëqui choquin tentencate cuëdëmec matses cuëdënsho tantiatuidpondash.
Aden tantiatuidashien aton papan namiaid istuidash: ‘¿Atotsi naic nec?’ quepondash bëyuc tishaid.
“Adoaquien: ‘Min utsi ënden nidondaid choaposh. Aidi chosho isash unësquiocquin nuquitedi bëdamboec tabadquin pemenuequin aton bacan bacuë nuacquid dapa papan cuesunemiosh,’ cac
bëyuc tishaid nëishash shubun puduedenquio icpondash. “Adsho isash, Puduedenquio iccosh, quequin chiac bëyuc tishaid yacno nidshun: ‘Min utsibobëd bëdambo icnuec cho, mado,’ capondash aton papan.
Adoaquien: ‘Seta dadpen matamequin mimbi chiacpadomboen nabanteniombi. Adquid icsho ëbëd capuquidobëdta ëbi pemenuen yua utsin bacuë mimbi cuesunemenquiocpaboc.
Nëbi mimbi meniaidtedi naimbudquinc, chido dada dadpen chudmequid chudquinc caic min mado choacsho isun bacan bacuë nuacquid mimbi cuesunemepacboc,’ quequin bëyuc tishaidën aton papa chushcapondash.
“Adoaquien: ‘Mado, ëbëd icquid mibi nec. Adquid icnuc con natedi mitsana neyoc.
Min utsi unësacbimboecboedi nëbi choash tabadoaic. Aidi bënudacbimboecboedi nëbi istuidaid nec,’ quequin aton papan choboedën buchi chuipondash —quepanëdash Esus.
